_doc: Texturverkstadens spakar (docs/texture-workshop.md). sources: källor (en per recept), steps: bildbehandlingssteg (en stapel), material: materiallabbets egenskaper (punktade nycklar i recipe.material; client: true = räknas i 3D-vyn utan att texturen görs om), blend: spakar per blandningslager (recipe.blend.layers, bara i 3D-vyn och klientens shader), layer_presets: färdiga lager, profiles: målprofiler (vem som använder texturen). Spaktyper: number, int, select, color, seed, texture, bool, input (en ingrediens), text. adv: true lägger spaken under Avancerat; when: {nyckel: värde eller [värden]} visar den bara när villkoret gäller. Färger anges som #RRGGBB i sRGB. presets: färdiga material som tumnaglar i verkstadens bibliotek (group, label, profile, recipe med source, steps, inputs och material).

params.label: Scale
params.help: Number of large shapes across the texture

params.label: Plates
params.help: Cross cracks that split the ridges into plates

params.label: Plates along
params.help: Plates along the trunk per tile; 0 = from Plates

params.label: Plate length
params.help: How many times longer than wide the plates are; 0 = from Plates

params.label: Cross cracks
params.help: Width of the cracks across the plates, compared with the long furrows

params.label: Plate tones
params.help: How much each bark plate varies in tone

params.label: Flakes
params.help: Sparse lighter flakes or lichen on the plate tops

params.label: Lenticels
params.help: Short horizontal dark dashes, as on cherry and birch

params.label: Furrow color
params.help: Own color in the furrows (e.g. orange inner bark on pine); empty = darker bark

params.label: Lichen and moss
params.help: Large soft patches of lichen or moss on the plates

params.label: Patch size
params.help: Number of patches across the texture

gradient.label: Gradient and shape
gradient.help: For masks and simple painted surfaces; a whole number of bands or cells, so it stays seamless

krea.label: Krea (painted with AI)
krea.help: Local ComfyUI with Krea-2. The first run takes about 3 minutes; the result is cached

params.label: Description
params.help: Describe the material only; the house style is added by House style

params.label: Shape from ingredient
params.help: Image to image: an ingredient sets the shape and Krea paints it. The Paint with AI button does this for you

params.label: Free interpretation
params.help: Low: the shape is kept and Krea only paints the surface. High: Krea invents more and follows the shape less

params.label: Relief from
params.help: The height (normal, AO) from the shape's algorithm, which has the right height, or from the image's brightness

ripples.label: Sand, snow and ripples
ripples.help: Wind ripples with a long gentle slope and a short steep lee side, winding and fading out in patches. Tileable in any direction

params.label: Ripples
params.help: How many ripples across the texture

params.label: Direction
params.help: Which way the ripples run (snapped so the texture stays seamless)

params.label: Steep side
params.help: Round waves at 0, sharp crests with a steep lee side at high values

params.label: Breakup
params.help: Patches where the ripples flatten out

params.label: Grains
params.help: Fine grain on top (keep it low for a stylized look)

cracks.label: Cracked ground and ice
cracks.help: Plates split by cracks of varying width, curling up at the edges like dried mud, with finer cracks in some plates

params.label: Curled edges
params.help: How much the plate edges lift, like drying mud

layer.label: Layer (ingredient with mask)
layer.help: Puts an ingredient on top, controlled by a mask: moss in the joints, dirt in the furrows

scatter.label: Scatter (stamps)
scatter.help: Leaves, pebbles or flowers scattered over the texture, seamlessly

params.label: Size
params.help: Share of the texture's side

params.label: Clumping
params.help: Gathers the stamps in groups

tile.label: Seamless
tile.help: Blends the edges with an offset copy, so the texture repeats without a seam

colorramp.label: Color ramp
colorramp.help: Recolors by height or brightness: dark in the hollows, light on the peaks

palette.label: Toward the palette
palette.help: Pulls every pixel toward the nearest color in the palette (tools/style.json)

edges.label: Edges and crevices
edges.help: Lighter edges on what sticks out and darker crevices, from the height (the style guide's edge light)

height.label: Height
height.help: Changes the height map (which drives normal, AO, layers and blending) without touching the color

warp.label: Warp
warp.help: Bends the pattern with soft noise, so straight shapes become more organic

gray.label: Grayscale (for tint)
gray.help: The color is then set in the material (leaf_tint, bark_tint)

soften.label: Softer contrast
soften.help: Tones down furrows and grooves but keeps large shapes

frequency.label: Frequency (large and small shapes)
frequency.help: The style guide wants low frequency: tone down the small shapes and keep the large ones

paint.label: Painted look
paint.help: Kuwahara filter: flat brush strokes that keep edges

range.label: Value limits
range.help: The style guide: no pure black or white (about 8–90 %)

repeat.label: Zoom (repeat)
repeat.help: Repeats the pattern several times within the texture, so it gets smaller in the world

cutout.label: Cutout (alpha)
cutout.help: Makes part of it transparent, by brightness or height

bleed.label: Fill transparent (bleed)
bleed.help: Gives transparent pixels the color of the nearest visible one, so mipmaps don't get a light fringe

stylize.label: Stylize
stylize.help: From photo to painted game material in one move: edge-keeping smoothing, fewer small details, the large forms kept and sharpened, fewer colors (in a perceptual color space), art-directed saturation and a simpler height, all from one strength

params.label: Strength
params.help: 0 keeps the material close to the source, 1 is fully painted

params.label: Colors
params.help: How many tones the material is reduced toward (5–12 suits most materials)

params.label: Large forms
params.help: How much the big forms (joints, cracks, ridges) are lifted and darkened from the height

params.label: Simplify height too
params.help: Normal and AO follow the simpler, broader forms

delight.label: Remove lighting
delight.help: For photos and AI images: takes out baked-in light and shadow so the color is a material, not a lit picture. Run it before Stylize

params.label: Light size
params.help: How large the light patches are, as a share of the texture

params.label: Meters per repeat
params.help: How large the texture is in the world

params.label: Parallax occlusion
params.help: Depth without extra geometry (UV mode)

params.label: Anisotropy
params.help: Stretched highlights, like brushed metal or hair

params.label: Detail map
params.help: A fine texture at high repeat that fades in up close

params.label: Anti-tiling
params.help: Randomizes the offset in tiles (texture bombing), so the pattern doesn't show across large areas

params.label: Macro variation
params.help: Large lighter and darker areas on top

params.label: Data maps color space
params.help: Normal, roughness, metal, AO and height must be linear; sRGB is a common mistake that gives wrong lighting

params.label: From height (share)
params.help: Within the model's height: 0 = ground, 1 = top

params.label: Edges or crevices
params.help: Positive: only on protruding edges (wear). Negative: only in crevices (dirt).

params.label: Covers the relief
params.help: How much the layer smooths the base's normal map (thick moss, snow)

source.prompt: hand-painted grey cobblestones with green moss in the joints
